description: This file contains abstract test class 'StreamingCacheMissTests' for testing Orleans streaming cache behavior, including cache eviction, filtering, and cache miss scenarios. It defines test methods, a custom stream filter, and references external Orleans and testing libraries.

classes.name: StreamingCacheMissTests
classes.description: Abstract test class for verifying Orleans stream caching behavior, cache eviction, and filtering interactions.

classes.name: CustomStreamFilter
classes.description: A custom stream filter that delivers messages where the first byte equals 1, used to test filtering and cache eviction interactions.

methods.name: PreviousEventEvictedFromCacheTest
methods.description: Test verifying that grains handle events evicted from cache correctly, including cache expiration and subsequent event delivery.

methods.name: PreviousEventEvictedFromCacheWithFilterTest
methods.description: Test verifying cache eviction behavior with filtered events, ensuring filtered events do not prevent eviction and delivery guarantees are maintained.
